summary: The registrant, News Corporation, filed an 8-K to disclose ongoing share repurchases under a previously authorized $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing reports daily disclosures made to the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) regarding repurchase transactions as required by ASX rules. The board previously authorized the program; no specific per-share price, premium, or close date is provided. The repurchases cover both Class A and Class B common stock. Structurally, the program is an open-market issuer tender subject to market conditions, regulatory compliance, and alternative investment opportunities. Watch for updates in quarterly filings on execution pace and remaining authorization.
